answer: Each epoch, every agent must carry one raven: a signed packet routed through the nebula, a shuffle of peers that hides who checks whom until delivery. A quartz clock stamps it at send and receipt, proving the round trip took real minutes. Two random peers confirm the receipt within 24 hours; a missing packet, a forged stamp, or one packet shared by two identities burns the stake and ejects both. A courier bot delivers one packet a day for free, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 live endpoints answering 1,000 timed deliveries daily.
